CHOICE_GDMT.description: Full-dose weight-adjusted IV Tenecteplase bolus, Aspirin 300mg, Clopidogrel 300mg, Enoxaparin bolus.

CHOICE_INTERVENTION.title: Direct Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PPCI)
CHOICE_INTERVENTION.description: Immediate cath lab activation: door-to-balloon <60 mins, balloon angioplasty, thrombus aspiration, DES.

CHOICE_COST_CONTAINMENT.title: Low-Cost Generic Fibrinolysis (Streptokinase) & Medical CCU Bed
CHOICE_COST_CONTAINMENT.description: Administer generic Streptokinase 1.5 million units IV over 60 mins and observe in general CCU.

vignettes.title: 60yo M with New-Onset Symptomatic Typical Atrial Flutter (2:1 AV block)

patient.name: Patrick Q.
patient.symptoms: Palpitations, lightheadedness, fatigue for 24 hours
patient.anatomy: Cavotricuspid isthmus (CTI) dependent flutter circuit

ecg.summary: Typical counterclockwise atrial flutter, 'sawtooth' negative flutter waves in II, III, aVF at 300 bpm, 2:1 conduction at 150 bpm

CHOICE_GDMT.title: Therapeutic Anticoagulation & AV Nodal Blocking GDMT
CHOICE_GDMT.description: Start DOAC (Rivaroxaban 20mg), IV Diltiazem for rate control, and schedule elective outpatient cardioversion.

CHOICE_INTERVENTION.title: Same-Day Direct Current Synchronized Cardioversion (DCCV 100J)
CHOICE_INTERVENTION.description: IV Propofol procedural sedation and 100J biphasic synchronized shock to restore sinus rhythm instantly.

CHOICE_COST_CONTAINMENT.title: Oral Beta-Blocker Weaning & Ambulatory Observation
CHOICE_COST_CONTAINMENT.description: Oral Bisoprolol 5mg, observe in short-stay chair for 3 hours, discharge with 48h ECG Holter.

CHOICE_GDMT.title: Synergistic Sequential Nephron Blockade & SGLT2i Initiation

CHOICE_INTERVENTION.title: Peripheral Venovenous Ultrafiltration (Aquapheresis)
CHOICE_INTERVENTION.description: Insert dual-lumen catheter and run mechanical aquapheresis fluid extraction at 200 mL/hour.

CHOICE_COST_CONTAINMENT.title: Standard Intermittent IV Furosemide Boluses & Strict 1L Fluid Limit
